newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bankruptcies up sharply in June qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bankruptcies up sharply in June qtr.

text.p: The number of Australians declared bankrupt jumped 28.5 percent in the June quarter over the same period last year, according to government statistics released on Monday.
The figures showed that 4,970 Australians were declared bankrupt in the three month period, compared to 3,867 in the previous corresponding period.
The statistics also showed that bankruptcies rose 21.8 percent to 17,867 in the 12 months to June 30, compared to 14,671 in the previous financial year.
